dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the output matrix from a certified floating-point triangular-substitution object. The result is an m-by-n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the computed matrix Yhat underlying computedData, the injectivity conclusion, and the definition of the error matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed preprocessing-data type for dimensions m, s, and n. Its constructor D017 packages dimension inequalities, matrices, sketch and factorization equations, injectivity assumptions, an isometric factor, and an invertible upper-triangular factor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified pre object supplies A, RHat, RHatInv, and all structural assumptions constraining admissible instances of the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the m-by-n real matrix A from the preprocessing data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A is used to define the exact matrix A RHatInv and as the input matrix of the computed triangular substitution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the n-by-n matrix RHat from the preprocessing data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: RHat is the upper-triangular right factor used by the floating-point substitution run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed run type tying preprocessing data and a floating-point model to a triangular-substitution object and an error matrix, as specified by constructor D018.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts run to contain a computed output and an error matrix equal to computed output minus A RHatInv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the m-by-n error matrix DeltaY from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: errorSpectrum certifies this matrix, and its upper spectral value enters the smallness hypothesis and condition-number bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the certified floating-point triangular-substitution object from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its output is the computed matrix whose injectivity and condition measure are concluded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified-data type for an m-by-n matrix. Constructor D020 packages spectra for the matrix and its Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, the pseudoinverse itself, and their required relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: exactData and computedData provide the exact spectral quantities and pseudoinverse spectral quantities used in both condition measures and in the perturbation size.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: A spectral certificate for a real matrix, constructed by D023 from nonnegative attained upper and lower Euclidean gain bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its upper fields represent exact induced Euclidean operator norms for the exact matrix, computed matrix, their pseudoinverses, and DeltaY.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating-point arithmetic model containing a nonnegative unit roundoff and addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division operations satisfying relative-error axioms from D025.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains the operations used to produce the computed triangular-substitution output, although unit roundoff does not occur explicitly in the final inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For certified data of a matrix M, returns matrixSpectrum.upper times pseudoinverseSpectrum.upper, namely ||M||_2 ||M^+||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the condition measure on both the exact matrix Y and the computed matrix Yhat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the exact m-by-n matrix Y as the matrix product A RHatInv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: exactData certifies Y, and the run error is DeltaY = Yhat - Y.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Returns errorSpectrum.upper times exactData.pseudoinverseSpectrum.upper, namely ||DeltaY||_2 ||Y^+||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This dimensionless quantity, denoted eta in the translation, is required to be less than 1 and appears in both numerator and denominator of the bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Maps an m-by-n matrix M to its matrix-vector linear map x maps to Mx, where (Mx)_i is the sum over all j of M_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines matrix injectivity, spectral gain bounds, norm preservation, and the explicit injectivity conclusion for Yhat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified floating-point triangular-substitution object for a matrix A and square matrix R. Constructor D027 supplies an output matrix satisfying the rounded recurrence and requires every diagonal entry of R to be nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its output is Yhat and is restricted to the specified rowwise triangular-solve computation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the n-by-n matrix RHatInv from the preprocessing data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is a certified two-sided inverse of RHat and defines the exact matrix Y = A RHatInv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs preprocessing data from 0 < n < s < m; A of size m-by-n; S of size s-by-m; computedSketch, sketchError, qrError, and Qtilde of size s-by-n; and RHat and RHatInv of size n-by-n. It requires A and SA to be injective, computedSketch = SA + sketchError, Qtilde RHat = computedSketch + qrError, Qtilde to preserve Euclidean norms, RHat to be upper triangular, and RHat RHatInv = RHatInv RHat = I.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are all implicit structural assumptions carried by pre. In particular, they make RHatInv a genuine inverse and make the exact matrix A RHatInv injective.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a run from a triangular-substitution object, an error matrix DeltaY, and the equation DeltaY = output - A RHatInv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the certified perturbation exactly as Yhat - Y.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the spectral certificate of the original matrix from a certified-data object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its upper value supplies ||Y||_2 or ||Yhat||_2 in the corresponding condition measure.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs certified data for A from a spectrum of A, a matrix Aplus satisfying the Moore-Penrose conditions, a spectrum of Aplus, and the implication that if the lower spectral value of A is nonzero then the upper spectral value of Aplus is its reciprocal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures the pseudoinverse and all spectral factors used by LocalDef011 and LocalDef013 are mathematically certified rather than arbitrary numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the n-by-m Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse from certified data for an m-by-n matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The pseudoinverse itself is not displayed in the conclusion, but its certified operator norm is used in the condition measure and perturbation size.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the spectral certificate of the pseudoinverse from a certified-data object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its upper field is ||M^+||_2, used in LocalDef011 and, for exactData, in LocalDef013.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a spectrum for A from nonnegative upper and lower values, universal bounds ||Ax||_2 <= upper ||x||_2 and lower ||x||_2 <= ||Ax||_2, and unit vectors attaining upper and lower respectively.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes upper and lower exact attained extremal Euclidean gains rather than merely loose estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the upper value from a spectral certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This value is the exact induced Euclidean operator norm used throughout the target quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a floating-point model with unit roundoff u >= 0. For every input pair, each operation equals the corresponding exact real operation multiplied by 1 + delta for some |delta| <= u; the division axiom applies when the divisor is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the relative-error semantics of every rounded operation in the triangular-substitution recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary finite matrix multiplication: (AB)_ij is the sum over k of A_ik B_kj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines SA, Qtilde RHat, the inverse equations, Moore-Penrose equations, and especially Y = A RHatInv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a triangular-substitution object with output Yhat, requires R_jj != 0 for every j, and requires Yhat_ij = flDiv(flSub(A_ij, rounded_sum_{k<j} flMul(Yhat_ik,R_kj)),R_jj) for every i and j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact algorithmic recurrence defining the computed matrix in every admissible run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proposition asserting that a matrix Aplus is a Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of A, with its constructor specified by D038.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It certifies the pseudoinverses carried by exactData and computedData.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the lower value from a spectral certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact minimum Euclidean gain and controls the certified reciprocal relation for the pseudoinverse norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n-by-n identity matrix, with entry 1 on equal indices and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the two-sided inverse equations for RHat and RHatInv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that Q preserves the Euclidean norm of every vector: ||Qx||_2 = ||x||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an encoded preprocessing assumption on Qtilde, although Qtilde does not occur explicitly in the final implication.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Entrywise matrix addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the sketch and factorization residual equations in the preprocessing data.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lower-gain bound c ||x||_2 <= ||Ax||_2 for every vector x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of each spectral certificate and gives meaning to its lower value.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: The upper-gain bound ||Ax||_2 <= c ||x||_2 for every vector x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of each spectral certificate and gives meaning to its upper value.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Entrywise matrix subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines DeltaY exactly as Yhat - Y.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that an n-by-n matrix R is upper triangular: R_ij = 0 whenever j < i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an encoded preprocessing restriction on RHat and is consistent with the triangular-substitution recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean vector norm ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the precise norm used by all spectral certificates, injectivity-related preprocessing assumptions, and condition quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs the Moore-Penrose relation from AAplusA = A, AplusAAplus = Aplus, transpose(AAplus) = AAplus, and transpose(AplusA) = AplusA.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the exact meaning of every pseudoinverse packaged in certified data.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects floating-point division from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the final rounded operation in each triangular-substitution recurrence step.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects floating-point subtraction from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It subtracts the rounded prefix inner product from A_ij in the recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: For indices i and j, computes the prefix inner product over k < j by applying floating-point multiplication to Y_ik and R_kj and combining the products with the model's floating-point addition fold.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the rounded accumulated term in the formula defining each computed output entry.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects floating-point addition from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines products in the rounded prefix inner product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects floating-point multiplication from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes each product Yhat_ik RHat_kj in the rounded prefix inner product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Proves that if j is an index below n and k is an index below the natural value of j, then k is also below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits prefix indices k < j to be used as valid matrix indices in the computed recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Folds a length-n real vector in index order using a supplied binary addition operation: it returns 0 for n = 0, the sole value for n = 1, and recursively combines the fold of the initial entries with the last entry for larger n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With floating-point addition, it specifies the association and base cases of the rounded prefix sum in D041.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Proves 0 < n + 1 under the branch assumption n = 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the bound needed to construct the sole finite index in the one-element case of the fold.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent natural-number case splitter for vectors indexed by Fin x, selecting an empty-length branch or a successor-length branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the zero-versus-successor cases of the rounded fold D045.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires both computed-matrix injectivity and the condition-measure inequality to hold.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts division from a division-and-inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real division for the fraction (kappa(Y) + eta)/(1 - eta).

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives all matrix and vector dimensions their exact finite index sets.

dependency_coverage.name: Function.Injective
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function f is injective when f(a1) = f(a2) implies a1 = a2 for every pair of inputs.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses full column rank of A, SA, and, in the conclusion, Yhat as linear maps.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real arguments it denotes ordinary addition in the numerator and in the expression 1 + delta.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the division operation supplied by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it denotes ordinary real division in the final condition bound and the model equations.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the subtraction operation supplied by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms 1 - eta and the exact differences used in error definitions and model equations.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies a supplied less-than-or-equal relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses the final bound and all nonnegativity and norm inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies a supplied strict less-than relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses the smallness condition eta < 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The dimensions m, s, and n and all finite-index values are natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a type equipped with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the literal 1 as a real number in eta < 1 and 1 - eta.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds the interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's distinguished one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies both displayed occurrences of 1 as the real number one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, vector entries, norms, spectral values, error quantities, and bounds are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary addition operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the numerator kappa(Y) + eta and all other exact real sums their usual meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative, inverse, and division structure, with division induced by multiplication by the reciprocal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary real division for the condition-number bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual less-than-or-equal order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It orders the computed condition measure and its upper bound and expresses nonnegativity constraints.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives eta < 1 its standard real-order meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished real number one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the threshold in the hypothesis and the constant in the denominator.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction, defined as addition of the additive inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms 1 - eta and entrywise exact differences.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a homogeneous addition operation into the HAdd interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the generic addition syntax in the target to ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a homogeneous division operation into the HDiv interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the generic division syntax in the target to real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a homogeneous subtraction operation into the HSub interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the generic subtraction syntax in the target to real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the finite enumeration of all elements of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the sums defining matrix-vector multiplication, matrix multiplication, and Euclidean norms finite sums over every valid index.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Sums a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines exact matrix products, matrix-vector products, and sums of squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies that the exact sums range over all matrix or vector indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the multiplication operation supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real arguments it forms matrix products, norm squares, relative-error expressions, and the products defining kappa and eta.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies zero and associative commutative addition for all finite real sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives all scalar and matrix-entry products their standard real meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a homogeneous multiplication operation into the HMul interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects generic multiplication syntax to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses all matrix identities, recurrence equations, attainment equations, and equal-output premises in injectivity.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies unit-vector witnesses attaining spectral upper and lower values and operation-dependent relative errors delta.

dependency_coverage.name: Inv.inv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the inverse operation supplied by an Inv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the reciprocal of a nonzero lower spectral value in certified matrix data.

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states nonzero matrix lower gain, nonzero divisors, and nonzero diagonal entries where required.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive group structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real negation and subtraction needed by absolute value and exact differences.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instInv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The reciprocal operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the inverse of the lower spectral value as an ordinary real reciprocal.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in nonnegativity conditions, nonzero conditions, identity matrices, and empty sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice-order structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the definition of absolute value used in the floating-point relative-error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds the interpretation of the numeral 0 from a type's distinguished zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets zero in spectral nonnegativity, nonzero conditions, identities, and fold base cases.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Absolute value, equal over the reals to max(a,-a).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds each floating-point operation's relative-error parameter by the unit roundoff.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the dimension restrictions and all finite-index bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets each natural-number literal as that natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural zero and one in dimension and recursion conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the underlying natural number from a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It compares row and column positions, determines prefix lengths, and enforces upper triangularity.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the power operation supplied by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It squares each vector entry in the Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it interprets x_i raised to the natural power 2 in the norm definition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies multiplication and natural powers for squared norm terms and underlies real division.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns the sum of squared entries into the Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality for finite indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the identity matrix to select 1 on the diagonal and 0 off the diagonal.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a power operation into the HPow interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the square notation in the Euclidean norm to ordinary real natural-number exponentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: A nondependent if-then-else chosen by a decidable proposition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines identity-matrix entries and a branch in the recursive rounded fold.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an element of Fin n from a natural value together with a proof that the value is below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constructs valid prefix and base-case indices used by the rounded recurrence and fold.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in alpha is a function m -> n -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the matrix representation used in the transpose conditions of the Moore-Penrose definition.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.transpose
dependency_coverage.meaning: Transposes a matrix by exchanging its row and column arguments.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the symmetry conditions on AAplus and AplusA in the Moore-Penrose equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: Embeds Fin n into Fin (n+1) while retaining the same natural value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the initial n entries when recursively folding a vector of length n+1.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.last
dependency_coverage.meaning: Returns the final index n in Fin (n+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the last entry combined at each recursive step of the rounded fold.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.below
dependency_coverage.meaning: Packages values of a recursion motive for all natural numbers below a given natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies prior fold results to the course-of-values recursion implementing D045.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.brecOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: Course-of-values recursion on natural numbers, allowing the current case to use recursively computed values for all smaller numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the length-recursive rounded fold used in the computed prefix sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard preorder structure on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural strict-order relation used by an index-bound proof.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number successor operation n maps to n+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It describes successor-length vectors and recursion cases in the rounded fold.

dependency_coverage.name: Not
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical negation: Not P means P implies false.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies all inequality and nonzero assumptions and the negative branch of dependent conditionals.

dependency_coverage.name: Preorder.toLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the strict-order relation from a preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the natural comparison used in the auxiliary prefix-index bound.

dependency_coverage.name: dite
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent if-then-else whose branches may use a proof of the condition or its negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports proof-dependent branching in the implementation of the rounded fold.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms successor sizes n+1 in finite-index and recursion constructions.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality for natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It decides the n = 0 branch in the rounded fold.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.casesOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number case analysis into zero and successor cases.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the vector-length case splitter D047.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.zero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the base length in natural recursion and appears in dimension, index, and nonzero conditions.

binders: Arbitrary natural numbers m, s, and n.
An arbitrary preprocessing object pre indexed by m, s, and n.
An arbitrary run associated with pre and the floating-point model.
An arbitrary certified-data object exactData for the m-by-n matrix Y = A RHatInv.

An arbitrary certified-data object computedData for the m-by-n computed matrix Yhat.
hypotheses: The preprocessing object contains dimensions satisfying 0 < n < s < m; matrices A in R^(m by n), S in R^(s by m), Qtilde in R^(s by n), and RHat and RHatInv in R^(n by n); sketch and factorization residual matrices of size s-by-n; and all associated proofs.
The maps x -> Ax and x -> SAx are injective.
The preprocessing equations are computedSketch = SA + sketchError and Qtilde RHat = computedSketch + qrError.
Qtilde preserves every Euclidean norm, RHat is upper triangular, and RHat RHatInv = RHatInv RHat = I.

The floating-point model has a unit roundoff u >= 0 and operations flAdd, flSub, flMul, and flDiv satisfying operation-dependent relative-error formulas with |delta| <= u; the division formula is required for nonzero divisors.
The run contains a computed matrix Yhat satisfying, for every row i and column j, Yhat_ij = flDiv(flSub(A_ij, rounded_sum over k < j of flMul(Yhat_ik,RHat_kj)),RHat_jj), with every RHat_jj nonzero.
Writing Y = A RHatInv, the run's error matrix satisfies DeltaY = Yhat - Y entrywise.

exactData certifies the exact Euclidean upper and lower gains of Y, a Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse Yplus, the exact gains of Yplus, and the reciprocal relation ||Yplus||_2 = 1/sigma_min(Y) when sigma_min(Y) is nonzero.
errorSpectrum certifies the exact upper and lower Euclidean gains of DeltaY, so its upper value is ||DeltaY||_2.
computedData analogously certifies Yhat, its Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, and their exact Euclidean upper and lower gains.
The perturbation quantity eta = ||DeltaY||_2 ||Yplus||_2 is strictly less than 1.
conclusions: The linear map x in R^n maps to Yhat x in R^m is injective.
The computed condition measure satisfies ||Yhat||_2 ||Yhat^+||_2 <= (||Y||_2 ||Y^+||_2 + eta)/(1 - eta), where eta = ||DeltaY||_2 ||Y^+||_2.
mathematical_definitions: Fin k is the index set {0,...,k-1}; an m-by-n real matrix is a function Fin m -> Fin n -> R.
For an m-by-n matrix M, (Mx)_i = sum over j in Fin n of M_ij x_j.
For compatible matrices M and N, (MN)_ij = sum over the shared finite index of M_ik N_kj.
For a finite real vector x, ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).

A spectral certificate for M contains nonnegative values sigma_max and sigma_min such that sigma_min ||x||_2 <= ||Mx||_2 <= sigma_max ||x||_2 for every x, with separate unit vectors attaining sigma_max and sigma_min. Thus these are exact attained extremal Euclidean gains.
A certified-data object for M contains a Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse M^+, spectral certificates for M and M^+, and, when sigma_min(M) != 0, the equation sigma_max(M^+) = 1/sigma_min(M).
The condition measure is kappa(M) = sigma_max(M) sigma_max(M^+) = ||M||_2 ||M^+||_2.
The exact matrix is Y = A RHatInv, the computed matrix is Yhat = run.forwardSubstitution.output, and DeltaY = Yhat - Y.
The perturbation size is eta = sigma_max(DeltaY) sigma_max(Y^+) = ||DeltaY||_2 ||Y^+||_2.
The rounded prefix sum uses 0 for an empty prefix, the sole product without an addition for a one-term prefix, and a recursively left-associated sequence of flAdd operations for longer prefixes.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every admissible choice of dimensions, preprocessing data, relative-error floating-point model, certified triangular-substitution run, and exact spectral and Moore-Penrose data for the exact and computed matrices, let Y = A RHatInv, let Yhat be the computed triangular-substitution output, and let DeltaY = Yhat - Y. If eta = ||DeltaY||_2 ||Y^+||_2 is less than 1, then Yhat has full column rank, and its spectral condition measure is bounded by kappa(Yhat) <= (kappa(Y) + eta)/(1 - eta).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The preprocessing type can be inhabited only with proofs of 0 < n < s < m; for dimensions not satisfying these inequalities, the universal proposition has no preprocessing instances and is vacuous.
The result is conditional on eta < 1. It makes no conclusion for a run lacking that smallness proof.
Certified spectral upper values and pseudoinverse upper values are nonnegative, so eta is nonnegative; together with eta < 1 this makes 1 - eta strictly positive.
Lean's real division is total even at zero, but the encoded smallness condition prevents the displayed denominator from being zero for certified inputs.

The proposition quantifies over preprocessing, model, run, spectrum, and certified-data objects rather than asserting that such objects exist. Failure to construct any required object makes the corresponding universally quantified case vacuous.
Every spectral certificate requires unit-vector witnesses attaining both extremal gains, not merely upper and lower inequalities.

The floating-point model is a pure relative-error model. It encodes no overflow, underflow, subnormal behavior, exceptional values, or absolute-error term, and it imposes no upper bound such as u < 1 on unit roundoff.
The hypothesis eta < 1 is not derived from unit roundoff, dimensions, sketch error, or QR error within this proposition.
The sketchError and qrError matrices are related to the preprocessing equations but are not quantitatively bounded in the target proposition.
No randomness, probability distribution, or probabilistic success statement for the sketch is encoded.
The computed output is restricted to the exact rounded recurrence packaged by the run; the theorem does not address an arbitrary approximate solution.
computedData is a separately supplied exact spectral and Moore-Penrose certificate for Yhat. The proposition does not encode a procedure that computes this certificate.
The bound concerns the Euclidean induced-norm product ||M||_2 ||M^+||_2. It does not state an elementwise error bound, a forward-solution error bound, or an explicit backward-error estimate.
The proposition concludes injectivity only for the computed matrix. Injectivity of the exact matrix is encoded indirectly through injectivity of A and the two-sided inverse equations for RHatInv.
All spaces are finite-dimensional real coordinate spaces; no complex, infinite-dimensional, or alternative-norm version is encoded.
